ideas.title: The Rise of Nonprofit Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the growing trend of nonprofit fraud in Minnesota, including the $5.4M scheme involving a daycare owner.
questions: What are the root causes of nonprofit fraud in Minnesota?
How can we prevent similar schemes in the future?
ideas.insight: This story would highlight the need for greater oversight and regulation in the nonprofit sector.

ideas.title: FBI Investigations into Fraud Cases
ideas.description: Explore the FBI's investigations into fraud cases, including the Argentine Soccer Federation and Feeding Our Future.
questions: What are the most common types of fraud investigated by the FBI?
How effective are these investigations in preventing future fraud?
ideas.insight: This story would provide insight into the FBI's efforts to combat fraud and protect the public.
